title: Fix scene-off RGB capture still lit after applied show flags
objective: Find and fix why scene_off_flashlight_off RGB frames remain bright even after scene-off show flags and console commands report applied/configured.
instructions: The latest validation completed successfully but failed visually and metrically: scene_off_flashlight_off median mean luma is still 136.18 and frame_0000 is brightly visible. This is after ShowFlag console commands all report applied=True and scene_off_lighting_isolation capture metadata reports configured=True with ShowFlagSettings property=ShowFlagSettings key_style=pascal.

Use the fresh output and log as evidence: examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_soft_falloff_validation/scene_off_flashlight_off/metadata.json and .control-tower/runs/soft_flashlight_falloff_validation_20260702T145744Z/render.log.

Deeply inspect how the RGB capture component is configured/read. Determine whether ShowFlagSettings are ignored by the SPEAR capture path, whether the RGB pass is an unlit/base-color material buffer, whether fixed-in-shipping flags like Materials cannot affect standalone, or whether capture source/postprocess needs to change.

Implement the smallest robust fix that makes no-flashlight scene-off RGB frames near-black. Prefer a real renderer/capture isolation fix over postprocessing the saved image; only use postprocessing if you can prove the capture path cannot represent direct-light-only RGB and document it in metadata/tests.
If direct-light-only requires changing capture source/show flags/scene capture settings, update the code and metadata so failed isolation is not reported as success without readback.
Preserve scene_on behavior and softened flashlight controls. Do not commit. Do not push.
